label: sec:knot-operator-basis-table-intro
html: This section tabulates how the torus-knot operators act on the normal-form (NF) basis of the Hecke algebra H_3(q), collected as a family of reference tables grouped by the inserted operator. Each table records the NF decomposition of the product b_i \cdot \beta(T_{m,n}) \cdot b_j — an incoming pair of basis elements b_i, b_j with the knot operator \beta(T_{m,n}) inserted between them — making the operator's effect on every pair explicit. Rows are indexed by the ordered pair (b_i, b_j) and columns by the six NF basis elements, so each entry is the coefficient of that basis element in the product, recorded as an exact polynomial in the Hecke amplitude h = q - q^{-1}. Reading across a row therefore shows which output channels a given operator opens for that incoming pair.
